title: A small locally constant and locally inhabited lattice-class sheaf
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite with valuation ring $A$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Use the continuous ring sheaves $A_X\to E_X$ [def-weil-pbc-lisse-lattice-coefficients] and sheaf modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. If $L$ is a finite locally free $E_X$-module, with varying ranks allowed, there exists a sheaf $F$ of sets in the same universe as the sections of $L$ on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], locally constant in the sense of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-locally-classical-etale-cover], and a pro-etale covering family $(U_j)_j$ on which $F$ has a section. For every $U\in X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, if $F(U)$ is inhabited, there is an integral lattice pair over the slice at $U$: a finite locally free $A_X|_U$-module $M$ and an isomorphism $E_X|_U\otimes_{A_X|_U}M\cong L|_U$, in the sense of [lem-weil-pbc-lattice-sheaf-locally-constant] and [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

proof.text: Apply coefficient normalization to obtain the commuting integral and rational sheaf isomorphisms and a finite locally free restriction of scalars of L.

Apply integralLatticeSheaf_locallyConstant to the lifted coefficient field and the normalized module. Its exact presentation and coset isomorphisms satisfy the hypotheses of the presentation-transport theorem; integralMatrixCosets is nonempty, including in rank zero.
Apply the shrinking and coefficient-transport theorem to obtain a small locally constant, locally inhabited sheaf with lattice representatives for the original coefficient map.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_lisse_lattice_class_sheaf (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (L : ringedSiteModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj (lisseFieldSheaf l E X)))
    (hL : L.IsFiniteLocallyFree) :
    ∃ F : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (Type (u + 1)),
      Scheme.IsProEtaleLocallyConstant X F ∧
      (∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (U : I → X.ProEt),
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology X).CoversTop U ∧
          ∀ i : I, Nonempty (F.obj.obj (op (U i)))) ∧
      ∀ U : X.ProEt, Nonempty (F.obj.obj (op U)) →
        Nonempty (IntegralLatticePair (lisseIntegerToField l E X) L U)
